main_text.p: stis, ut puto, mutuatis aliquid jam & ipse delibaveram; sed certe primis tantum labiis, qvippe qvi res illas tanqvam levissimi ponderis contempseram; qvinimo primis, qvæ inspexeram, illius artis fundamentis, ipse etiam proprio Marte nonnulla alia philosophando adstruxeram, qvæ num Hebræis sint usitata, ex te cognoscere mihi pergratum erit: vi-delicet, non modo ex literarum numeris, seu simplicibus seu qvadratis, iisqve excerptis, vel ex literis simpliciter vel ex literarum nominibus expansis in qvali-bet dictione, aut nomine, vel si mavis sententia, aliqvam reconditi sensus in-terpretationem Gmetrice, ut loqvuntur, elici posse; verum etiam, eodem nume-ro denuo in literas commutato, ex signi-ficatione dictionis, qvæ ex resultantibus literis emergit; exempli gratia; ex ve-nerabili nomine Jesu, qvod ab Arabibus scribitur Isua ישוע[?] si literarum numeros supputemus, colligentur 146. qvo nu-mero iterum in literas resoluto exorietur dictio Caʋin משיח[?], qvæ Arabice sonat In-

page.notes: The Hebrew words (ישוע and משיח) and the Latin-letter forms (Isua, Caʋin) are read from a small, faint scan and are uncertain; the Hebrew letters in particular should be checked against the original. The first word "stis" is a fragment from the previous line. "L 6" and "servi-" are read as the gathering signature and catchword. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
